headline: NYY @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 2.93 at CLE 3.30, with a projected total of 6.23. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: NYY moved -1.79 runs while CLE moved +0.74, changing the projected margin by -2.53 runs. The projected total fell -1.05, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Gavin Williams has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Ben Rice, José Ramírez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Stuart Fairchild because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
